Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

CaseBasedReasoning (development version)

Bug fixes

  • Factor values in queries are now matched to the training data by level name instead of internal integer code. Queries with different or dropped factor levels previously got silently wrong distances. Unknown levels are now an error (#4).
  • Character predictors no longer break distance calculation after fit() (#5).
  • Training cases with missing values are excluded consistently from fitting, distance calculation and retrieval. A single NA used to make get_similar_cases() fail. Missing values in the query are now an informative error (#6).
  • get_similar_cases() validates k: it must be a whole number and at most the number of training cases (#7).
  • get_similar_cases(merge = TRUE) works for queries without endpoint columns (#8).
  • variable_selection() now returns the variables retained by rms::fastbw() instead of all variables. Further arguments are passed on to fastbw(), and update = TRUE restricts the model to the selected variables (#9).
  • proximity_distance() converts proximity to distance as sqrt(1 - p). It previously used sqrt(max(p) - p), so distances depended on the observations in the batch. Absolute distance values change; the neighbour order within a query does not (#10).
  • Depth distance no longer loses the edge counts of earlier trees in forests with more than one tree. Depth distances were too small, and neighbour rankings could be wrong (#28).
  • weighted_distance() defaults to equal weights instead of 1, 2, ..., p and checks the length of weights (#14).
  • RFModel no longer forces verbose = TRUE for ranger (#15).
  • The threads argument of distance_random_forest() only applies to that call, and the previous RcppParallel setting is restored (#17).
  • Regression weights for numeric variables are no longer double-named (#18).
  • Depth distance no longer precomputes a table over all pairs of terminal nodes. Edge counts are computed on demand from each tree’s parent and depth arrays: n = 1500 with 100 trees now takes seconds instead of not finishing, and memory is linear in the number of nodes (#12).
  • orderMatrix() honours sortDirection in TBB builds and clamps k to the number of rows (#25).
  • Corrected the DOI of Englund & Verikas (2012) (#19).

New features

  • get_similar_cases(exclude_self = TRUE) excludes training cases with the same row name as the query, so in-sample queries do not return themselves (#13).

Internal

  • Removed dead and duplicate C++ code (cpp_weighted_knn(), cpp_orderVector(), unused containers and headers) and fixed compiler warnings (#24, #25).
  • Added value and regression tests for distances and retrieval (#26).
  • Tests use at most 2 threads.
